title: Ability Session Pinning
summary: Client requests are bound to an AbilitySession, which pins a specific AbilityGeneration and its underlying Runtime Snapshots.
why: Allows the server to rotate global runtimes and profiles without breaking existing sessions.
invariants: An AbilitySession pins a specific AbilityGeneration.
Staging a profile captures one runtime snapshot and owns those leases for the warm lifetime of the generation.
Publishing a new profile (P2) does not change existing sessions (P1).
evidence_note: Source: runtime_registry_v0.14/README.md:105-120. Line 106: 'An AbilityProfileRevision describes one immutable client-facing configuration.'
